import os
import math
import numpy as np
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as robot
from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr

# Create Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create ground body with contact material and add it to the system
ground_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(20, 20, 1, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.5))  # Position the ground slightly below the origin
ground.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the ground in place
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"))
system.Add(ground)

# create a long box for rover to cross
box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(0.25, 5, 0.25, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.0))
box.SetFixed(True)
box.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/blue.png"))
system.Add(box)
# Create Curiosity rover and add it to the system
rover = robot.Curiosity(system)

# Create driver for rover
driver = robot.CuriosityDCMotorControl()
rover.SetDriver(driver)

# Initialize rover position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(-5, 0.0, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChFramed(init_pos, init_rot))

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Curiosity rover - Rigid terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 3, 3), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step

    # ask rover to move forward
    driver.SetSteering(0.0)

    # Update rover dynamics
    rover.Update()

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

import os
import math
import numpy as np
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as robot
import pychrono.sensor as sens

# Create Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create sensor manager
sens_manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)

# Create ground body with contact material and add it to the system
ground_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(20, 20, 1, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.5))  # Position the ground slightly below the origin
ground.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the ground in place
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"))
system.Add(ground)

# Create a long box for rover to cross
box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(0.25, 5, 0.25, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.0))
box.SetFixed(True)
box.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/blue.png"))
system.Add(box)

# Create Curiosity rover and add it to the system
rover = robot.Curiosity(system)

# Create driver for rover
driver = robot.CuriosityDCMotorControl()
rover.SetDriver(driver)

# Initialize rover position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(-5, 0.0, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChFramed(init_pos, init_rot))

# Create a lidar sensor for the rover
lidar_update_rate = 10  # Hz
lidar_horizontal_samples = 360
lidar_vertical_samples = 1
lidar_range = 10  # meters
lidar_fov = math.radians(80)
lidar_noise_std_dev = 0.01
lidar_min_range = 0.1

lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor()
lidar.SetUpdateRate(lidar_update_rate)
lidar.SetHorizontalSamples(lidar_horizontal_samples)
lidar.SetVerticalSamples(lidar_vertical_samples)
lidar.SetRange(lidar_range)
lidar.SetFOV(lidar_fov)
lidar.SetNoiseStdDev(lidar_noise_std_dev)
lidar.SetMinRange(lidar_min_range)

# Attach the lidar sensor to the rover's chassis
lidar_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(0.2, 0.1, 0.2)
lidar_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
lidar.Initialize(rover.GetChassisBody(), lidar_pos, lidar_rot)

# Add the lidar sensor to the sensor manager
sens_manager.Add(lidar)

# Set up filters for the lidar data (optional)

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Curiosity rover - Rigid terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 3, 3), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step

    # ask rover to move forward
    driver.SetSteering(0.0)

    # Update sensor manager
    sens_manager.Update()

    # Update rover dynamics
    rover.Update()

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

```python
import chrono
import chrono.irrlicht as irrl
import chrono.collision as col
import chrono.vehicle as veh

# Initialize the PyChrono engine
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('path/to/data') # Set the path to the data folder
my_ ChronoEngine = chrono.ChronoEngine()

# Add rigid terrain
terrain = my_ ChronoEngine.AddTerrain(
    'path/to/terrain/heightmap.txt',  # Terrain heightmap file
    100.0,  # Terrain width
    100.0,  # Terrain depth
    5.0,    # Horizontal resolution (voxel size)
    1.0,    # Vertical resolution (voxel size)
    col.ChMaterialSurface::MakeDefault(),  # Ground material
    True    # Visualize the terrain
)

# Create the Curiosity rover
rover_model = my_ ChronoEngine.AddModel(
    'path/to/curiosity/model.obj',  # Rover 3D model file
    veh.ChChassis()                # Rover chassis
)

# Add motor control driver for real-time steering inputs
steering_driver = veh.ChSteeringDriveline(
    my_ ChronoEngine.GetSystem(),
    rover_model.GetChassisBody(),
    veh.ChSteeringDriveline.STEERING_RACK,
    0.1,  # Steering ratio
    2.0   # Max steering angle (rad)
)

# Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions
# ... (Set up the initial position, orientation, and other parameters here)

# Initialize the Irrlicht visualization system
my_app = irrl.ChIrrApp(my_ ChronoEngine.GetSystem(), 'Curiosity Rover Navigation', irrl.dimension2d<int>(800, 600))

# Customize camera settings, lighting, shadows, and additional visual elements
my_app.SetCameraPosition(chrono.ChVector(10, 15, 10))
my_app.SetCameraTarget(chrono.ChVector(0, 0, 0))
my_app.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector(0, 10, 0), chrono.ChVector(0, 0, 0))
my_app.AddTypicalLights(irrl.vector3d<float>(-50, -50, -50), irrl.vector3d<float>(50, 50, 50))
my_app.SetShadowQuality(irrl.E_SHADOW_QUALITY_HIGH)

# Start the simulation
my_app.Run()
```

Replace `'path/to/data'`, `'path/to/terrain/heightmap.txt'`, and `'path/to/curiosity/model.obj'` with the actual file paths in your system.
